summary: The Board of Vocational Education and Rehabilitation, Division of Vocational Rehabilitation, appeared in the state agencies roster and submitted a brief letter indicating it had little knowledge of the construction project and foresaw no adverse environmental impact or material effect on its functions. The agency returned the submitted documents due to storage constraints and expressed no objection to the project.
